summary.text: David Trumble is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Jim Creighton.
A farmer, small business owner and college debate coach with a law degree, he also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: David Trumble earned a bachelor's degree from the Catholic University of America in 1979 and a law degree from the University of New Hampshire School of Law in 1983.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been a certified organic farmer for 40 years and a college debate coach for more than 40 years, and that after law school he set up a law clinic serving people in the mental health system.

Trumble was a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives in Hillsborough District 44 in 2022 and lost the 2024 State Senate District 8 general election to incumbent Ruth Ward.
He said in the survey that he has testified at the State House more than 100 times, especially in support of public school funding.
His stated key messages were civility in politics, an economy that works for everyone, and stronger public schools through a larger state share of funding.
